metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2006 · Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man's Chest
metas.description: Jack Sparrow races to recover the heart of Davy Jones to avoid enslaving his soul to Jones' service, as other friends and foes seek the heart for their own agenda as well.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2002 · Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
metas.description: Harry Potter lives his second year at Hogwarts with Ron and Hermione when a message on the wall announces that the legendary Chamber of Secrets has been opened. The trio soon realize that, to save the school, it will take a lot of...

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2007 · Pirates of the Caribbean: At World's End
metas.description: Will Turner, Elizabeth Swann, Hector Barbossa, and the crew of the Black Pearl try and rescue Jack from Davy Jones's locker, and prepare to fight Lord Cutler Beckett, who controls Davy Jones and the Flying Dutchman.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2005 · Constantine
metas.description: Detective Angela approaches Constantine, a demon hunter, to help her investigate her twin sister's mysterious death. As he digs deeper, he realizes that demons are trying to enter the human world.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2006 · The Illusionist
metas.description: In turn-of-the-century Vienna, a magician uses his abilities to secure the love of a woman far above his social standing.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2003 · Underworld
metas.description: Selene, a vampire warrior, is entrenched in a conflict between vampires and werewolves, while falling in love with Michael, a human who is sought by werewolves for unknown reasons.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2008 · Hellboy II: The Golden Army
metas.description: A prince of the mythical world starts a rebellion against humanity in order to rule the Earth. Hellboy and his team must fight to stop him from locating the all-powerful Golden Army.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2006 · Perfume: The Story of a Murderer
metas.description: Jean-Baptiste Grenouille, born with a superior olfactory sense, creates the world's finest perfume. His work, however, takes a dark turn as he searches for the ultimate scent.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2006 · Stranger Than Fiction
metas.description: I.R.S. auditor Harold Crick suddenly finds his mundane Chicago life to be the subject of narration only he can hear: narration that begins to affect his entire existence, from his work to his love life to his death.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2007 · Bridge to Terabithia
metas.description: Leslie and Jess create the secret kingdom of Terabithia, a land of monsters, trolls, ogres and giants where they spend their free time ruling as king and queen and fighting evil creatures.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2009 · The Time Traveler's Wife
metas.description: Henry DeTamble, a librarian, possesses a unique gene that lets him involuntarily travel through time. His wife, Claire Abshire, finds it difficult to cope with it.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2005 · The Jacket
metas.description: A Gulf war veteran is wrongly sent to a mental institution for insane criminals, where he becomes the object of a doctor's experiments, and his life is completely affected by them.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2007 · Across the Universe
metas.description: The music of The Beatles, New York in the 1960s, and the American youth's actions to protest the Vietnam War, form the backdrop for the romance between an upper-class American girl and a poor Liverpudlian artist.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2001 · Shaolin Soccer
metas.description: A young Shaolin follower reunites with his discouraged brothers to form a soccer team using their martial art skills to their advantage.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2009 · Enter the Void
metas.description: An American drug dealer living in Tokyo is betrayed by his best friend and killed in a drug deal. His soul, observing the repercussions of his death, seeks resurrection.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2006 · The Science of Sleep
metas.description: A man entranced by his dreams and imagination is love-struck with a French woman and feels he can show her his world.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2006 · Wristcutters: A Love Story
metas.description: A film set in a strange afterlife way station that has been reserved for people who have committed suicide.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2009 · Thirst
metas.description: Through a failed medical experiment, a priest is stricken with vampirism and is forced to abandon his ascetic ways.
